findings_and_safeguards.first_contract: Breastplate validation first validates profile, then for Anime invokes anime.validate(raw wall_thickness), and only afterward enforces wall thickness 1–20 mm. Millimeters is a public u16 wrapper and BreastplateDesign and AnimeDesign have public fields and declared Deserialize. Anime scalar predicates precede lap_lift < gauge.0 * 2. With earlier predicates passing and gauge >=32768, u16 doubling overflows before the outer gauge check.
findings_and_safeguards.guard_and_condition: The profile and Anime scalar guards run first; Solid does not enter the Anime branch. With overflow checks enabled, a reachable overflow can panic instead of returning the typed validation result; with checks disabled wrapping can lead to different first errors. Gauge 1–20 makes doubling numerically safe, but the separate lap relation can still reject a combination. No actual malformed input, macro, loader, device, geometry or runtime was executed; supported caller, configured overflow checking and eventual presentation remain unresolved. No invalid mesh acceptance is claimed.
findings_and_safeguards.concrete_source_paths: The current JSON loader parses then calls validate_breastplate, and DeviceBreastplate::record validates before device construction. These are source call edges, not proof that an actual caller supplied a malformed document or that every ingress is protected. Default profile values satisfy its visible predicates and default Anime fields satisfy preceding scalar predicates; this supports the conditional source reasoning only.
findings_and_safeguards.historical_relation: 774 rig F049 recorded the same gauge-first-failure family with old 6533 pr-working range; 059 q641 and ledger /segovb_continuation/conditional_connected_contracts/4 retain Segovb source candidate and READ-L11-427, with separately attributed P16 READ-L11-445. Prior /root/rig_identity REVIEW-ANIME-GAUGE-ORDER-CURRENT and /root/hair_ops P16 and role2609 reports independently trace the same conditional relation. Central decides final ledger identity and repair dependency; none of the historical sources becomes 3821.
findings_and_safeguards.future_direction: Establish supported raw authoring ingress and required structured error boundary; later repair should preserve correct admitted gauge/lap relations and legitimate construction modes while preventing unchecked pre-admission arithmetic. No implementation begun.

findings_and_safeguards.evidence: The screen helper divides/remainders by size for nonzero alpha and records normalized occupied pixel indices. The shown rasterize_icon invokes render then passes its coverage buffer and size to occupied_bounds. The visible render path rejects sizes outside 16–512 and supersampling outside 1–8; resolve loops exactly size by size pushing one coverage element per output pixel. Empty coverage leaves nonfinite empty bounds and produces None.
findings_and_safeguards.condition: These are source relationships conditional on the selected render returning successfully; unrelated rendering correctness and input validation were not assessed. The maximum bound represents the last occupied pixel index divided by size; whether downstream contract needs that index, pixel-center, or outer pixel edge is a separate unresolved policy. No renderer or image is run.

thirteen_bounded_perspectives.admission-contracts: Outer and nested validator order admits a raw u16 arithmetic boundary before the parent bound.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.aggregate-states: Anime lap/gauge coupling is distinct from individually valid thickness and warmup alternate state.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.invariant-operations: Gauge multiplication can overflow before admission; valid 1–20 thickness cannot overflow this multiplication.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.existing-type-owners: Millimeters and validated design gates already exist, with potential owner/gate policy unresolved.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.type-ownership: Validation, postcard errors and catalog namespace have distinct owning boundaries.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.type-granularity: Raw authoring Millimeters, admitted wall gauge and lap separation are related but not identical contracts.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.enum-shapes: Solid and Anime represent meaningful construction alternatives; only Anime enters the gauge relation.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.producer-propagation: Loader and device gates are visible source edges; actual caller and runtime remain unproved.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.redundant-authority: Validated design hashes and raw-byte hash serve different roles; no duplicate authority inferred without callers.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.magic-numbers: Wall 1–20, laps, pixel size and alpha threshold are scoped domain/raster constraints with distinct roles.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.magic-strings: Catalog id, error text and PNG codec context are separate semantic/diagnostic questions.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.derivability: Derived Deserialize admits authoring data but does not replace parent and cross-field validation.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.behavior-preservation: Keep valid Solid and Anime, bounded gauge/lap semantics, existing pixel-bound convention until policy is decided, and structured error intent.
